review_scope: Every prose paragraph, equation, table caption, and figure caption

sections.sentence_basis: Study identity, sampling order, sample sizes, deposit and longitudinal differences, component confound, and retained-evidence boundary. The disclosed high-level classifier gate failure is checked against the report.

Motivation and comparison to prior calorimeter-surrogate practice; external claims carry primary citations, including the 2025 ZDC journal study and 2026 co-activation study. The last paragraph specifies the measured quantities and development-bank role.
Feature semantics, target definition, channel/layer counts, graph construction, split counts, and development-bank role.

Every response, reference-target, masked-flow, graph-message, perturbed top-k, decoder, and nine-term-loss equation is bound to an implementation source blob in the mathematical-exposition audit. Each retained equation has a distinct reader purpose; notation for readout quantities, masks, flow context, graph functions, ranks, and losses is defined near use. Sampling and training statements distinguish provisional/final visibility, current-state numerical updates, teacher forcing, and exact decoder constraints; no physics-fidelity implication is inferred.

Definitions follow the metric equations and evaluator. The adjacent-layer graph implication follows from edge construction. The zero-fraction and hit-count intervals, original C2ST scores, row-wise split, and separate pair-grouped monitor are checked against their respective records.

Every numeric result is reproduced from the immutable aggregate report, including zero-fraction and hit-count intervals, all-event edge co-occupancy, three-seed C2ST scores, and the failed high-level gate. Structural gap/component intervals and component energies are absent.

Longitudinal reach and gaps lead interpretation; component counts are confounded by adjacent-layer geometry. The final energy-sharing flow cannot alter sampled support in exact arithmetic. Potential mechanisms are stated as possibilities with corresponding ablation or oracle tests.

sections.section: Availability, acknowledgments, contributions, and AI disclosure
sections.sentence_basis: Repository contents were checked directly. The author confirmed substantial Codex/GPT-5.6-Sol roles and personal ownership of the main ideas and verification; authorship and acknowledgment remain author declarations.

style_checks.result: source prose and equation clarity reviewed; exact typeset inspection recorded separately
style_checks.policy: Prefer named variables, operations, evidence, and limits over promotional or vague language.

visual_review: Exact-PDF visual inspection is recorded separately in the release-bound visual-review record.
